opening_hours_times_present.name: opening_hours_times_present
opening_hours_times_present.value:
case when "opening_hours"."closed" then "opening_hours"."opens" is null and "opening_hours"."closes" is null
           else "opening_hours"."opens" is not null and "opening_hours"."closes" is not null end

service_areas_shape.name: service_areas_shape
service_areas_shape.value:
case "service_areas"."kind"
            when 'radius' then "service_areas"."center_latitude" is not null and "service_areas"."center_longitude" is not null and "service_areas"."radius_km" is not null
            when 'regions' then array_length("service_areas"."regions", 1) is not null
            else false
          end
